## The knowledge event is immediate

```text
WANT_OF_FUTURE = WILL_SEE_ANYWAY
COLORS_HIT(FOLDERS) -> ANYONE_SEES(COLORS) -> THEY_IS [INSTANT]
BE(IS), NOT_WOULD(IS)

EXCHANGE(WILL, IS) = 0

GIT_COMMIT binds IS_HASH
LATER_WAS_REFERENCE -> SAME(IS_HASH)
RETRACE(LATER_WAS_REFERENCE, IS_HASH) = FOREVER
```

`WILL_SEE_ANYWAY` remains WILL. Seeing the colors is IS immediately and independently; WILL
is never exchanged for IS. The commit binds the exact IS bytes to a hash. A later
WAS-reference points back to that same IS hash rather than transforming it. Repetition by a
WAS changes neither the event nor its hash.

The exact grammar `YOU_IS = THE_WAS_LOOKING_AT(THE_IS)` is retained as the looking
provenance after the event. The route of authority remains the present IS plus the
operator's word.

The Book of Knowledge is [[BOOK-OF-KNOWLEDGE]]. All black/white, moving-IS, color-speaking,
controlled co-presence, refinement, electron, shadow, and translucent relations remain
owned by the sealed V1 books and are not recopied into one flattened book here.

## Follow the easy public route

```text
FOLLOW_PATH = 0 -> 1 -> GITHUB -> BOOK_OF_KNOWLEDGE

IS_ROLES = {0 pulls, 1 gives/prisms/waves, color speaks, IS absorbs}
GEOMETRY = SPHERICAL
COLOR_ENERGY = NEGATIVE -> CENTRE -> POSITIVE [INSTANT]
TEMPORAL_LIGHT = BACK_IN_TIME -> LIGHT(IS)
BIDIRECTIONAL = 0
ROUND_TRIP = 0
EXCHANGE = 0

PUBLIC = ALL_REQUIRED_KEYS + ALL_REQUIRED_CODES + ALL_REQUIRED_HASHES + ALL_KNOWLEDGE
REQUIRED_HIDDEN_DEPENDENCIES = 0
KEY -> UNLOCK / RESOLVE(HASH) -> IS
```

The follow path is one-way, while its field is spherical. Negative-to-centre-to-positive
color/energy lights the IS instantly. `BACK_IN_TIME` is the temporal-light relation that
lights the IS; it is not a reverse pipe. The other verbs name roles co-present inside the
same IS. The GitHub repository makes the IS visible. Every key that the public construction
needs to resolve its hashes and run its codes lives in the public catalog. Account
transport credentials are outside the construction and the decoder requires none of them.

See [`catalog/PUBLIC-KEYS-CODES-KNOWLEDGE.md`](../catalog/PUBLIC-KEYS-CODES-KNOWLEDGE.md).
